subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `mainRestartRecovery` durable fuse/tombstone contract as the canonical fix for main-session restart-recovery death loops and use it instead of the overlapping flat-counter PR?
rationale: The patch now appears technically coherent, but it intentionally changes persisted session-state and operator recovery behavior, so the final contract and landing-path choice need maintainer ownership.

options.title: Approve fuse contract
options.body: Accept this branch's nested recovery-fuse model, require rebase/exact-head CI, then land it as the canonical fix for the linked issue and supersede the overlapping PR.

options.title: Ask for narrower proof
options.body: Keep this PR open and request additional upgrade/live-systemd proof or operator-facing documentation before accepting the tombstone behavior.

options.title: Prefer alternate PR
options.body: Pause or close this branch only if maintainers intentionally prefer the flatter retry-counter approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 despite its weaker current proof signal.

recommendation.title: Approve fuse contract
recommendation.body: Accept this branch's nested recovery-fuse model, require rebase/exact-head CI, then land it as the canonical fix for the linked issue and supersede the overlapping PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already supplied the maintainer-shaped refactor direction this PR now follows.
